rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education instruction; up to 15 hours may be approved continuing professional development (per Board memorandum)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Those licensed during the current biennium (e.g. Jan 1, 2025 - Dec 31, 2026) need no proof of CE at their first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of renewal materials; audited licensees must provide proof of all CE completed within the biennium.

rules.notes: Biennium Jan 1 - Dec 31 of the following year (2025-2026); renewal due by Dec 31, late fee $200 until Mar 1. At least 15 hours live/face-to-face; home study max 15 hours.
rules.rule_quote: …To renew your active license for the 2027-2028 biennium, you are required to complete 30 hours of continuing education pursuant to the revised version of NAC 641.136
